faqs.question: What is HambakTech Enterprise?
faqs.answer: HambakTech Enterprise is an all-in-one Nigerian technology portal providing instant identity validation (NIN, BVN, CAC), telecommunications vending (SME data, VTU airtime, bill payment), digital payment processing, and technology academy courses.

faqs.question: How does the NIN and BVN verification work?
faqs.answer: We query sovereign databases via authorized adapters (2SureVerify and Veripine). You input the 11-digit NIN or BVN, and within seconds receive the certified biodata, official photograph, and printable NIMC slip.

faqs.question: How quickly is SME data delivered to the recipient?
faqs.answer: Our telecom gateway dispatches data bundles through direct integration with UlamaData and VTpass carrier bridges. Delivery typically completes in 2 to 10 seconds.

faqs.question: How do I fund my wallet balance?
faqs.answer: You can fund your wallet using automated Flutterwave card checkout or via instant bank transfer to your dedicated Moniepoint virtual account.

faqs.question: Can I integrate HambakTech services into my own software?
faqs.answer: Yes! All verification and telecom services provide authenticated REST API endpoints with webhook support for developers and resellers.
